name: City of Batavia utility billing

evidence_legend.observed_public: Captured from live public city pages on 2026-10-04 (read-only, no form submission).
evidence_legend.documented: Stated in the city-linked six-page Paymentus guide (5il.co/3a7g4), the Paymentus FAQ (5il.co/3a7g3), the current Billing & Payment page or the city Direct Payment form (5il.co/3emxt).
evidence_legend.synthetic: Reconstructed for this environment because the live Paymentus tenant (ipn2.paymentus.com/cp/cobi) returns HTTP 403 to public capture; values are fixtures, not production behavior.

observed_public.identity: Batavia Illinois city utility billing; catalog water-sewer record only. City billing may combine services; no other Batavia records are mapped.

city_direct_draft.execution: monthly utility balance on due date
city_direct_draft.enrollment: Call utility billing or return authorization form in person, drop box, or regular mail; do not email sensitive form data.

paymentus_autopay.fees: Fees apply; current numeric fees not established by a live quote
paymentus_autopay.duplicate_warning: Do not enroll again in Paymentus if enrolled in city Auto Pay; current page warns of duplicate payments.

documented_current_policy.multi_account: FAQ: tie all accounts to the Paymentus account and make one payment; guide menu: make a payment on one or more accounts

documented_guide_behavior.evidence_scope: Currently linked official six-page guide, with December 2020 sample; documented layout, not current live portal observation

fields: Service Address Street Number (everything before the first space)
stages: Review billing address/name, choose email/SMS notification, accept Payment Authorization Terms
link_account.paperless_default: No as shown; Yes disables paper mail

documented_guide_behavior.recovery: Enter email; follow instructions emailed. Link versus temporary password, expiry, and private continuation unknown.
documented_guide_behavior.posting: Guide says next business-day credit and up to 48 hours for website balance/paperless changes; no precise current cutoff/calendar.

notification_preferences.controls: Edit Notification Email and Mobile under More; paperless can be switched back to paper bills

wallet.capability: View or change methods of payment

documented_guide_behavior.my_profile: Guide page 5: View or change general settings for your login
documented_guide_behavior.payment_history_scope: Guide page 5: shows payments made online or through your bank only; not mail or in person

synthetic_schedule_policy.evidence: Neither the city guide nor FAQ documents future-dated payments; this follows common Paymentus portal behavior and is labeled synthetic.
synthetic_schedule_policy.execution: 00:00 UTC on the chosen date, before same-instant AutoPay
synthetic_schedule_policy.reservation: none until execution; balance, link and saved-method version rechecked then
synthetic_schedule_policy.edit: date and amount while scheduled, with optimistic version

source_conflicts_and_limits: FAQ describes a December 14, 2020 upgrade, not a new 2026 rollout.
Guide uses old cityofbatavia.net links and a December 2020 example. Its fee/limit values must not be silently treated as current checkout policy.
Current billing page distinguishes free city draft from fee-bearing processor AutoPay; these are separate enrollment states.
Historical FAQ states 18-month history and limited channel visibility; no current live verification.
PDF membership/fee policies from Charlotte County or other Paymentus tenants do not apply automatically.
Google Pay/payment wallets do not imply Sign in with Google.
The 141 child sources collected from city pages belong to the Apptegy city frontend, not the inaccessible Paymentus authenticated SPA. They do not establish billing portal source completeness.
fidelity_limits: No authenticated production session or payment has been observed; the live Paymentus tenant is HTTP 403 to public capture.
Entry fields, menu and Accounts layout follow the 2020 city guide; visual styling is a reconstruction.
Scheduled payments are a synthetic Paymentus-platform rule; Batavia documents none.
Multi-account payments are recorded as one confirmation with per-account ledger rows and the single fee on the first row.
Mock Gmail delivers all notices locally; SMS is never sent.
unfinished: Usable current live portal auth/registration/recovery captures (tenant returns HTTP 403)
Original private checkout/receipt layout, current fee quote, settlement and cutoff policy
Commercial fee tier, PayPal/Venmo wallets and pay-by-phone
Original statement PDF layout/line items and live history retention

construction_draft.login: Documented email/password labels and navigation; synthetic credential validation and account continuation
construction_draft.recovery: Documented email entry and delivery; synthetic reset link, 15-minute expiry, 10–128-character passwords, one-use grants and session revocation
construction_draft.registration: Guide-based portal registration, account/address-prefix verification, consent, paperless and notifications; backend validation, review lifetime, terms and sample data synthetic
construction_draft.billing: Guide navigation and synthetic authenticated linked-account bill/bank/card review/receipt, backed by authoritative ledger; current checkout layout, fees and settlement unverified
construction_draft.payment_history: Documented navigation with synthetic local ledger records, masked instruments, account-link scope and preserved pending status; live retention/channel coverage unknown
construction_draft.bill_history: Documented navigation with synthetic original amount, posted/pending sums, unpaid availability, linked scope and synthetic statement downloads; original line items/layout and live retention unverified
construction_draft.notification_preferences: Documented account-level email/SMS and reversible paperless capabilities; synthetic combined edit form, immediate update and no live outbound delivery
construction_draft.statements: Guide View Bill download action with immutable synthetic PDFs from seeded invoices; linked-account/session scope and byte integrity checked. Original statement layout and line items unobserved.
construction_draft.wallet: Documented My Wallet navigation with reconstructed profile-scoped add/edit/remove forms and saved-method checkout; storage, duplicate rules and review invalidation synthetic
construction_draft.account_summary: Guide due/balance/Pay Bill/More controls with synthetic ledger aggregation and earliest outstanding due date, pending reservations separate from posted credit; original current aggregation/timing unverified

construction_payment_policy.description: Fixture values: $3.50 per bank/card payment and $500 per-payment limit, from the guide's historical residential tier ($8.25/$5,000 commercial tier not modeled). Current live fees/limits are unverified.
construction_payment_policy.posting: Immediate posted synthetic outcome; current processor settlement and cutoff unverified
construction_payment_policy.multi_account: One service fee per combined payment; total limited to transaction_max_cents

construction_autopay_policy.evidence: synthetic; guide documents AutoPay navigation only
construction_autopay_policy.schedule: one attempt per existing future invoice at due-date midnight UTC
construction_autopay_policy.cancellation: Stops future attempts, retains submitted payments
